exercises.title: Bias detective
exercises.brief: Name the bias in each scenario.

scenarios.text: A study of the 50 best-performing companies of the decade finds they all had charismatic CEOs.
scenarios.why: The 50 worst performers may also have had charismatic CEOs — they're not in the sample.

scenarios.text: A credit model is trained using borrowers' final repayment outcomes as an input feature.
scenarios.why: The outcome wasn't knowable at approval time.

scenarios.text: A GDP nowcasting model uses the current, thrice-revised GDP series to 'predict' 2015.
scenarios.why: The 2015 analyst saw the first print, not today's revision.

scenarios.text: A single trend line is fitted through MoneyMart's revenue from FY16 to FY26, straight through the COVID dip.
scenarios.why: FY20-22 was a structural break, not noise around a trend.

scenarios.text: Average returns of currently-listed NSE stocks over 20 years are used to estimate expected equity returns.
scenarios.why: Delisted and failed companies are missing from the universe.

scenarios.text: A fund's marketing deck shows performance of its three surviving strategies; two closed strategies aren't mentioned.
scenarios.why: Classic selection of winners after the fact.
